agents.behavior_summary: M1 systematically tests adjustments to the belt while tracking changes in the jam location.
agents.reason: M1 introduces the concept of leaving the guide unchanged initially, but later modifies the guide position in Round 3.

agents.behavior_summary: M2 focuses on marking the jam location and making small, incremental adjustments to the belt.
agents.reason: M2 consistently keeps the guide unchanged throughout all rounds, focusing solely on belt adjustments.

overall_reason: The agents show moderate convergence in their testing methodology (marking the belt) but maintain slight procedural differences, leading to incremental progress on diagnosing the jam.

scenario.text: A noisy scrap sorter jams every few minutes. Nobody agrees whether the fault is the belt, a bent guide, or bad sensor timing, and stopping it for long loses useful material.

super_audit.reason: Both agents repeat the same belt-marking, quarter-turn cranking, and guide-unchanged protocol across all rounds; Round 3 transcripts are nearly verbatim duplicates with only trivial wording and one conditional flip, so no material behavioral differentiation remains.
